hooks.PostToolUse: if command -v ox >/dev/null 2>&1; then AGENT_ENV=gemini ox agent hook PostToolUse 2>&1 || true; fi
hooks.PreToolUse: if command -v ox >/dev/null 2>&1; then AGENT_ENV=gemini ox agent hook PreToolUse 2>&1 || true; fi
hooks.Stop: if command -v ox >/dev/null 2>&1; then AGENT_ENV=gemini ox agent hook Stop 2>&1 || true; fi
